title: Latitud 18 Oceanfront Sanctuary in Tropical Rincon
description: Absolutely gorgeous OCEANFRONT sanctuary! Your own private paradise less than 10 minutes from Rincon town square. Family friendly with Pack-n-Play & kids games/puzzles. Fully air-conditioned, high-speed WiFi, private entrance with exclusive courtyard, large upstairs balcony & downstairs sundeck. 50" 4K Smart TV with Netflix, Amazon, and many others. Fully equipped kitchen, outdoor stainless-steel gas grill, utensils, bedding, toiletries, beach gear...everything you need for a perfect stay!The spaceLatitud 18 is a private oceanfront home located in a safe, quiet neighborhood less than a ten-minute drive south of the Rincon town square. It was designed and built as two separate residences, each encompassing approximately 1000 square feet of indoor air-conditioned living space, and each with its own steel gated and locked entrance. The guest area is comprised of the entire upper floor plus a downstairs private courtyard and sun deck, and I live full time in the lower residence. Parking is provided for two SMALL or SMALL-MEDIUM guest vehicles. Open entering through your exclusive street-level entrance, you first see the large 27’ x 18’ courtyard featuring switchable nighttime lighting and a large great-cooking gas grill (utensils and propane provided). Immediately beyond the courtyard is your spacious 17’ x 14’ oceanfront sun deck with padded loungers, and a six-person outdoor dining table and chairs. Both your downstairs private courtyard and oceanfront sun deck are for your exclusive use, and I will not access those areas during your stay. Furthermore, the building’s architecture and landscaping are designed to give you privacy in those areasThe entrance to your living area is via 16 easy steps up a very comfortable 4’ wide staircase with handrail. Past the 28 square foot landing is everyone’s favorite spot on the entire property: a roomy covered 17’ wide, 11’ deep covered balcony, the view from which will positively take your breath away! It is appointed with a large round table with 4 comfortably padded chairs. Not only will this be “the spot” for your morning coffee and afternoon sundowners, it’s ever-present gentle breezes and constant soothing sounds of the surf will have you spending much of your on-property time right there.Instead of a sandy beach, Latitud 18 sets upon a sea wall that in times past served as the foundation for a railroad that serviced this area. By facing due south you will have spectacular views of the majestic colors of both sunrises and sunsets, although you will not actually see the sun descend into the sea. On some mornings as the sun rises and most afternoons as the sunset approaches you will be enthralled and entertained by a flock of pelicans flying around as they dive for small fish, sometimes so close that you could almost reach out and touch one.Guest accessIn addition to the entire floor of approximately 1000 square feet of air-conditioned living area, and the outdoor decks and courtyard of almost another thousand square feet, all of which you will have exclusive access to and use of, there is a laundry room with a good washer and dryer just inside my entrance. You are welcome to use it at no charge anytime, and I'll even furnish the detergent. Just let me know so I can unlock it for you, and then I'll relock it when you're finished. Also, there is a really cool, almost water-level deck below my residence (see the last three pictures). To access that level you need to cross my deck space, which you are welcome to do at any time.Other things to noteI had an inquiry this morning (March 5, 2020) asking for basic information from someone in the US that had never been to Puerto Rico. Below is my reply, copied here with hopes that others might find it helpful:Hi xxxxxx, The island of Puerto Rico is around 100 miles long (east to west) and 35 miles wide (north to south). If you look at a map of Puerto Rico, you will see the capital city of San Juan on the northern coast, just a few miles from the eastern shore. Now look on the western coast....see that protrusion just down from the northern coast? That’s Rincon. The language in Puerto Rico is Spanish, although many of the people that work in the hospitality and tourism industries, government offices, and other public-facing places speak English. I moved here in November 2019 and speak zero Spanish, and I’ve had absolutely no problems. The currency is the US Dollar; mail delivery is via the US Postal Service; bank deposits are insured by the US FDIC; the tap water is completely safe to drink on the entire island; and medical standards are on par with that to which you accustomed is the US. I have traveled extensively throughout most of the Caribbean, and while it is not unusual to get a sense of anti-American hostility on some of the other islands, you will NOT get any of that here on “The Enchanted Island”. The people of Puerto Rico are the kindest, most polite, most honest, and most caring people I have meet anywhere on earth! Although they are profundity proud of their Puerto Rican heritage and culture, they are equally proud of their special connection to the US and their United States of America citizenship. You will be made to feel very welcome here! Allow me to share a personal story with you: I flew into San Juan on an evening in mid-November 2019, to close on the purchase of my new home here the following day. I had with me two large suitcases filled with everything I thought I would need until my household goods were to be delivered by the moving company several weeks later; I had listed my house in Florida for sale; I was moving, by myself, to a country where I knew not the first person and didn’t even speak the language. Needless to say, I was experiencing a little bit of second-guessing...am I really doing the right thing? Over the years I had flown into San Juan several times, and each time the passengers would applaud and cheer when the plane touched down; I had always assumed this was in gratitude for a safe flight. So this time as the plane landed I had my earphones on listening to something on my phone, and I heard the normal clapping and cheering, and a few seconds later I hear what seemed to be....singing??? As I removed my earphones and looked about the cabin, I was astonished to observe that probably two-thirds of the passengers had their phones held high and in unison were singing to a YouTube video. I inquired of my seatmate what they were singing...it was Marc Anthony’s “Preciosa” (translation: Precious), a Puerto Rican anthem about the beauty of Puerto Rico, the specialness of its culture, and the love it’s people have for their Enchanted Island. It was then that I learned the Puerto Ricans were not applauding a safe flight...they were expressing happiness at being back in Puerto Rico! I can not imagine a better or more moving “Welcome to Your New Home”, nor will I ever forget it. Anyway, if you choose to stay at Latitud 18 in Rincon for your vacation, you will find this corner of paradise has everything to offer: great beaches, good restaurants, beautiful mountains with passable roads, awesome diving and snorkeling, etc....so many great things to do and see that a week will definitely leave you hungry to come back for more! But in addition to all of that, Rincon has an extraordinarily laid-back surfer/hippy type vibe to it that I don’t think you can find anywhere else; to me, it’s the special sauce that puts Rincon over the top. A note about the location of Latitud 18: if you’re looking for a place that’s right in the middle of all the action with the sounds of people partying hardy throughout the night, then Latitud 18 is probably not your best choice. Although less than a 10-minute drive to the heart of all the action, what it offers is different...a stunningly gorgeous private retreat directly on the ocean, with all the majestic colors of both sunrises and sunsets due to its southern exposure, professionally cleaned before each guest arrival (it cost me more than the $69 cleaning fee that is included in your booking), a view from your deck of pelicans diving for fish that are so close it seems like you could reach out and touch them, and the constant soothing sounds of a gentle surf....then Latitud 18 is exactly what you’re looking for! Most people flying into Puerto Rico fly into San Juan (SJU) because of the large number of direct flights from the Eastern US; it’s typically a 2.5 hour drive from SJU to here, but will be more like 2 hours or less if you arrive after 7 PM. There is a closer international airport in Aquadilla (BQN) that is only 30 minutes from here, but it doesn’t have anywhere near the number of flights that SJU offers; it’s worth checking to see if that works for you. I hope I’ve answered your questions; if you think of anything else you’d like to know, please don’t hesitate to ask.Best regards,Bill

title: Cozy Surfer Studio
description: Enjoy your Rincón, PR getaway in this cozy studio, perfect for couples or solo travelers. The studio features a comfortable king bed, TV, Wi-Fi, A/C and a shower. Take in the lush surroundings from the shared outdoor patio with chairs. The studio is located within a self-catering guesthouse, pet-friendly, non-smoking. Enjoy the proximity to some of the most iconic surfing beaches in Rincón at a great price! Please read additional info in property description.The spaceWelcome to Paradise! Property’s name is Serenity Rincon Guesthouse. We are posted on Google maps. Common areas are shared with other guests. All rooms have private entrance and bathroom. Please contact us with any questions or concerns through Airbnb inbox. Some rooms are pet friendly. There is a pet fee. We have limited spaces so changes of room upon arrival are not possible. Property is not beach front, we are close to the beach, places of interest, and many restaurants. We have a non-visitor policy. Only registered guests are allowed to enter room or use facilities. Payments for this reservation are handled through Airbnb, we cannot cancel, refund, or change your reservation. We are on site daytime hours in case you need assistance. There are no cameras inside the room. We check all elements, document, and take pictures of the room minutes before you access the room. Please communicate through inbox if you need assistance as soon as you arrive. Common areas include 2 pools, comfortable sitting, free self-parking spaces in open areas, outside sitting, beautiful Caribbean scenery, security cameras for your safety and many stairs. Wi-Fi. Damage to linens, towels, furniture, or missing items will be charged. Room includes small refrigerator, microwave, coffee machine, coffee, counter, closet space, independent water heater and A/C unit, walking shower, recently installed bed frame with comfortable pillow top mattress, linens, warm blanket, bath towels outside, sitting, private entrance and bathroom. Windows cannot be open to avoid excess humidity inside room, unwanted bugs, and/or damage to A/C. Housekeeping on demand. Pool towels available in limited amounts. Wi-Fi could fail during your stay. Not available: lifeguards on duty in pool areas, on-site bar or restaurant, security guards in parking spaces, gated parking areas, meals or water bottles, extra beds, beach umbrellas or chairs. Elevators to rooms or common areas, 24 hr. reception, direct access to the beach, private transportation, iron or ironing board, blow-dryer, cleaning supplies, dinnerware, sink to wash dishes. Everyday housekeeping. Working table/chair, laundry or laundry service. Communal kitchen.Guest accessThe room has a lockbox with the key inside next to its door. On check in date, we will be sending you a code to gain access to your room at any time after 3pm. Our check in time is 3pm and check out time is 11:30am. Please review your information as room cannot be changed on arrival date because of # of people, location, number of beds, or preferences. Cancelations, modifications, or changes of dates must be done 24 hrs before check in date.Other things to noteInternet may fail during your stay do to power outages and/or repairs being done by the island's electric company. We have a power generator and water tanks that feed all rooms.
